chunks.ar: كان رجل قد ترك السرقة وتاب عنها،
chunks.en_old: A former thief repented
chunks.en_new: A man had given up stealing and repented of it,

chunks.ar: وفتح دكانًا يبيع فيه الأقمشة في السوق.
chunks.en_old: and became an honest cloth merchant.
chunks.en_new: and opened a shop selling cloth in the market.

chunks.ar: عمل مدة في التجارة، وأصبح يعرف بضائعه جيدًا،
chunks.en_old: He ran his shop for some time
chunks.en_new: He traded for a while and came to know his goods well,

chunks.ar: وكان يغلق المحل عند المساء ويعود إلى بيته مطمئنًا.
chunks.en_old: and closed it each evening before going home.
chunks.en_new: and he closed the shop in the evening and went home at ease.

chunks.ar: في ليلة جاء لص آخر إلى السوق،
chunks.en_old: One night another thief came
chunks.en_new: One night another thief came to the market,

chunks.ar: وقد ارتدى ثيابًا تشبه ثياب صاحب الدكان، وحمل مفاتيح معه.
chunks.en_old: dressed like the merchant, carrying keys.
chunks.en_new: dressed like the merchant, carrying keys.

chunks.ar: رأى حارس السوق، وطلب منه أن يشعل له شمعة،
chunks.en_old: He asked the market watchman to light a candle,
chunks.en_new: He saw the market watchman and asked him to light a candle for him,

chunks.ar: كأنه جاء ليتفقد حساباته.
chunks.en_old: pretending to check his accounts.
chunks.en_new: pretending to check his accounts.

chunks.ar: بينما ابتعد الحارس لإحضار النار،
chunks.en_old: While the watchman went to get a flame,
chunks.en_new: While the watchman went to get a flame,

chunks.ar: فتح المحتال الدكان ودخل إليه وأشعل شمعة أخرى.
chunks.en_old: the impostor opened the shop.
chunks.en_new: the trickster opened the shop, went in and lit another candle.

chunks.ar: وعندما عاد الحارس وجده جالسًا بين دفاتر الحساب،
chunks.en_old: The guard returned to find him bent over account books,
chunks.en_new: When the watchman returned, he found him sitting among the account books,

chunks.ar: يعد الأرقام بأصابعه، فلم يشك في أمره.
chunks.en_old: apparently calculating figures.
chunks.en_new: counting figures on his fingers, so the watchman did not suspect him.

chunks.ar: بقي المحتال في الدكان حتى الفجر،
chunks.en_old: At dawn
chunks.en_new: The trickster stayed in the shop until dawn,

chunks.ar: ثم طلب من الحارس أن يحضر رجلًا مع جمل لنقل بعض الأقمشة.
chunks.en_old: the impostor asked for a camel-driver.
chunks.en_new: then asked the watchman to bring a man with a camel to carry some cloth.

chunks.ar: حمل الرجل أربع رزم كبيرة،
chunks.en_old: He loaded four large cloth bales,
chunks.en_new: The man loaded four large bales,

chunks.ar: وانصرف بها مع اللص، الذي أعطى الحارس درهمين.
chunks.en_old: departed with them, and tipped the watchman two dirhams.
chunks.en_new: and left with them and the thief, who gave the watchman two dirhams.

chunks.ar: وصل التاجر الحقيقي صباحًا،
chunks.en_old: The real merchant arrived
chunks.en_new: The real merchant arrived in the morning,

chunks.ar: فاستقبله الحارس بترحيب زائد بسبب الدرهمين اللذين ظن أنهما منه.
chunks.en_old: to unusual friendliness from the guard, who thought he had been tipped.
chunks.en_new: and the watchman greeted him warmly because of the two dirhams he thought came from him.

chunks.ar: تعجب صاحب الدكان، ثم فتح الباب،
chunks.en_old: Inside, the merchant noticed
chunks.en_new: The shop owner was puzzled, then opened the door,

chunks.ar: فرأى آثار الشموع والدفاتر على الأرض، واكتشف اختفاء الرزم الأربع.
chunks.en_old: candle wax and missing bales.
chunks.en_new: and saw traces of candles and the books on the floor, and found the four bales gone.

chunks.ar: سأل التاجر الحارس عما حدث، فعرف خبر الرجل والجمل.
chunks.en_old: He questioned the watchman,
chunks.en_new: The merchant asked the watchman what had happened and learned about the man and the camel.

chunks.ar: طلب إحضار سائق الجمل، وسأله أين نقل الرزم.
chunks.en_old: found the camel-driver and learned where the goods had gone.
chunks.en_new: He sent for the camel driver and asked him where he had taken the bales.

chunks.ar: قاده السائق إلى مخزن قريب من الميناء، حيث وضع البضائع قبل شحنها.
chunks.en_old: The driver led him to a storeroom near the port.
chunks.en_new: The driver led him to a storeroom near the port, where he had left the goods before shipping.

chunks.ar: دخل التاجر المخزن، فوجد الرزم الأربع مربوطة كما تركها،
chunks.en_old: The merchant found his four bales still bound as before,
chunks.en_new: The merchant found his four bales still bound as before,

chunks.ar: وقد وضع اللص عباءته فوقها.
chunks.en_old: with the thief’s cloak thrown over them.
chunks.en_new: with the thief’s cloak thrown over them.

chunks.ar: أخذ التاجر الأقمشة والعباءة،
chunks.en_old: He recovered the goods
chunks.en_new: The merchant took the cloth and the cloak,

chunks.ar: وأعاد تحميل البضائع، ثم مضى مع سائق الجمل نحو السفينة.
chunks.en_old: and took the cloak as well.
chunks.en_new: reloaded the goods, and went off with the camel driver toward the ship.

chunks.ar: لحق اللص بالتاجر بعدما رأى أن حيلته فشلت،
chunks.en_old: The thief followed,
chunks.en_new: The thief caught up with the merchant after seeing that his trick had failed,

chunks.ar: وقال له إنه استعاد أقمشته كاملة،
chunks.en_old: admitting that the merchant had recovered his goods
chunks.en_new: and told him that he had got all his cloth back,

chunks.ar: وطلب أن يعيد له عباءته.
chunks.en_old: and asking for his cloak back.
chunks.en_new: and asking for his cloak back.

chunks.ar: ضحك التاجر وأرجع العباءة دون مشاجرة، ثم انصرف كل واحد منهما في طريقه.
chunks.en_old: The merchant laughed, returned it, and they parted.
chunks.en_new: The merchant laughed and gave back the cloak without a quarrel, then each went his own way.
